summary: Removed whole optional sentences across all six sections to reduce the draft by roughly 600 words, weighting cuts toward the over-length Palmerston/Cambridge House, Butler-quarrel and Fryston sections. Surviving sentences are otherwise unchanged except for three small pronoun repairs. All eight protected excerpts are retained.
